name: verso-ui
description: The window's HTML/TypeScript (Phase 2, walking skeleton). Talks to the core only through the generated bindings.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/main.js --sourcemap && cp index.html style.css dist/ && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/
